message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'
      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x gradlew
      - name: Cache NPM
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: |
            .gradle/nodejs
            build/spotless-*
            build/tmp/spotless-register-dependencies
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('.prettierrc') }}-${{ hashFiles('.nvmrc') }}
      - name: Start Gradle Daemon
        run: ./gradlew --dry-run
      - name: Check formatting
        run: ./gradlew spotlessCheck --info --stacktrace
      - name: Build with Gradle
        run: ./gradlew --info --stacktrace
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: ./gradlew test --info --stacktrace
      - name: Run end to end tests
        run: ./gradlew e2eTest --info --stacktrace
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: ./gradlew integrationTest --info --stacktrace
      - name: Stop Gradle Daemon
        if: always()
        run: ./gradlew --stop
      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2.24.0
        if: (!cancelled())
        with:
          files: build/test-results/**/*.xml",
  "rationale": "The workflow lacks a job-level timeout, leaving it vulnerable to runaway execution. Historical runs complete in 2-3 minutes, so a 10-minute timeout provides ample operational headroom while bounding worst-case resource consumption. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern is supported by measured evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing 26.8% elapsed time savings on a comparable workflow, and the pattern catalog reports 12.9%/8.1% VM time reduction (free/paid). The change preserves all build and test steps and introduces no new permissions or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
